Callout.Name: Missing Swimmer
Callout.Message: Swimmer not seen for thirty minutes at a lake.
Callout.Advisory: Friends on the shore, no sighting.

Script.Line: He went in off the rocks half an hour ago.
His towel and his keys are still on the rock.
Nobody has seen him come out of the water.

Lines.Approach: Thirty minutes and nothing. The friends are on the shore and they are not sure where he went in.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
